### Checklist
- [ ] The file's sources are the journal's own pages (or its publisher's), and each says when it was read.
- [ ] The figure sizes (widths and the deepest a figure may be) are the ones those pages give.
- [ ] The word and item limits are the ones those pages give, and `limits.checked` is the day I read them.
- [ ] The preview the check makes (PDF and Word) looks like a manuscript for this journal.
- [ ] The file is the only file this pull request changes, and its name is its id (`journals/<id>.json`).
- [ ] It changes a journal already in the library, so I raised its `version` (or: it's a new journal).
- [ ] `verified.status` is `"community"` (only a maintainer sets `"verified"`).
- [ ] It contains no publisher's files (no class, style or template files: `latex.files` names them only).
- [ ] **I agree my contribution is CC0**: dedicated to the public domain under CC0 1.0, as the rest of the library is (see LICENSE).
